items.name: Editor
items.tip: Waveform editor: select, cut, copy, paste, trim, fades, normalize, reverse and more, with undo.

items.name: Sampler
items.tip: Turn the audio (or your selection) into an instrument: play it from a keyboard or MIDI, with pitch, loop, slices, envelope and filter.

items.name: FX
items.tip: Drive, Transistor and Fuzz from PurrOne, squash, duck, delay and reverb from the shimmer plugin. Works on the sampler, or on the preview, or can be applied to the audio.

items.name: Auto-Tune
items.tip: Auto-Tune and pitch corrector: pulls a voice or lead onto the notes of a key, from natural to hard and robotic. Runs live in the plugin.

items.name: Pitch Editor
items.tip: Melodyne style editor: the pitch of the file becomes note blobs on a piano roll. Drag notes up, down and sideways, change vibrato, drift and formants per note.

items.name: Harmony
items.tip: Harmony voices (thirds, fifths, octaves that follow the key) and a robot voice locked to one note.

items.name: Test audio
items.tip: Pick a test sound to edit. Reloading it throws away your edits.

items.name: Open file
items.tip: Open your own audio file (wav, mp3, flac, ogg). It is edited in this browser tab only and never uploaded.

items.name: Play
items.tip: Play from the cursor, or the selection. Shortcut: Space.

items.name: Loop
items.tip: Loop the selection while playing. Shortcut: L (Editor).

items.name: Undo
items.tip: Undo the last edit. Shortcut: Ctrl+Z.

items.name: Redo
items.tip: Redo. Shortcut: Ctrl+Y.

items.name: Export WAV
items.tip: Save the edited audio as a 16-bit WAV file to your computer.

items.name: Send to CATalog
items.tip: Hand the edited audio to CATalog's library. Plugin and desktop app only.

items.name: CUT
items.tip: Remove the selection and keep a copy. Shortcut: Ctrl+X.

items.name: COPY
items.tip: Copy the selection. Shortcut: Ctrl+C.

items.name: PASTE
items.tip: Insert the copy at the cursor, or over the selection. Shortcut: Ctrl+V.

items.name: DELETE
items.tip: Remove the selection. Shortcut: Delete.

items.name: SILENCE
items.tip: Replace the selection with silence.

items.name: TRIM
items.tip: Keep only the selection and remove the rest.

items.name: FADE IN
items.tip: Ramp the selection (or whole file) up from silence with the chosen curve.

items.name: FADE OUT
items.tip: Ramp the selection (or whole file) down to silence.

items.name: NORMALIZE
items.tip: Raise or lower the selection (or whole file) so its peak hits the target level.

items.name: GAIN
items.tip: Apply the gain amount below to the selection (or whole file).

items.name: REVERSE
items.tip: Play the selection backwards.

items.name: INVERT
items.tip: Flip the polarity of the selection.

items.name: REMOVE DC
items.tip: Remove a constant offset from the selection.

items.name: Zoom out
items.tip: Zoom out. Mouse wheel works too.

items.name: Zoom in
items.tip: Zoom in.

items.name: FIT
items.tip: Show the whole file.

items.name: SELECTION
items.tip: Zoom to the selection.

items.name: Scale

items.name: Overview
items.tip: The whole file. Drag the pink window to scroll.

items.name: Mode
items.tip: Keys: the sample is pitched across the keyboard. Slices: the sample is cut into pieces and each piece sits on its own key from C4 up.

items.name: Voices
items.tip: Poly: chords and overlapping notes. Mono: one note at a time, with glide between notes.

items.name: Root
items.tip: The key that plays the sample at its original pitch. Double-click resets.

items.name: Tune
items.tip: Transposes everything in semitones. Double-click resets.

items.name: Fine
items.tip: Fine tune in cents. Double-click resets.

items.name: Bend
items.tip: Pitch bend amount. A MIDI pitch wheel adds up to 2 semitones on top. Double-click resets.

items.name: Glide
items.tip: Mono mode: slide time between notes. Double-click resets.

items.name: Resample
items.tip: Plays the sample at its root note through the amp, filter and FX, and replaces the selection (or the whole file) with the result. Undo brings the old audio back.

items.name: Start
items.tip: Where in the sample (or selection) the note begins. Also the orange line on the waveform. Double-click resets.

items.name: Loop
items.tip: Keys mode: keeps repeating between the two green markers while the key is held. Drag the markers on the waveform.

items.name: Loop L
items.tip: Loop start inside the sample. Drag the green L marker on the waveform. Double-click resets.

items.name: Loop R
items.tip: Loop end inside the sample. Drag the green R marker on the waveform. Double-click resets.

items.name: Reverse
items.tip: Plays the sample backwards.

items.name: Slice by
items.tip: Even grid: equal pieces. Transients: cuts where the sound hits (drums, chops).

items.name: Slices
items.tip: How many pieces in Slices mode. Slice 1 is C4, slice 2 is C#4, and so on. Double-click resets.

items.name: Attack
items.tip: Fade in time. Double-click resets.

items.name: Decay
items.tip: Time to fall from the peak to the sustain level. Double-click resets.

items.name: Sust
items.tip: Level while the key is held. Double-click resets.

items.name: Rel
items.tip: Fade out time after you let go. Double-click resets.

items.name: Gain
items.tip: Level of the sampler. Double-click resets.

items.name: Vel
items.tip: How much the key velocity changes the volume. Double-click resets.

items.name: Pan
items.tip: Stereo position. Double-click resets.

items.name: Type
items.tip: Filter on every note.

items.name: Cutoff
items.tip: Filter frequency. Double-click resets.

items.name: Reson
items.tip: Emphasis at the cutoff. Double-click resets.

items.name: Env
items.tip: How far the amp envelope moves the cutoff, up to 5 octaves. Negative sweeps down. Double-click resets.

items.name: Track
items.tip: Higher keys open the filter more. Double-click resets.

items.name: Oct −
items.tip: Move the computer keyboard one octave down.

items.name: Oct +
items.tip: Move the computer keyboard one octave up.

items.name: Panic
items.tip: Stops every sounding note at once.

items.name: MIDI
items.tip: Connect a MIDI keyboard (asks your browser for permission). Note on and off and pitch bend are used.

items.tip: Window size. Drag any edge or corner of the plugin to resize it; the shape stays the same. Double-click here for 100 %.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turns Drive on or off.

items.name: Drive
items.tip: PurrOne's tanh drive. Smooth and round. Past 80 % a second stage stacks on. Double-click resets.

items.name: Trans
items.tip: PurrOne's Neve style transistor stage: asymmetric clipping, warm even harmonics, a bit more low end. Double-click resets.

items.name: Fuzz
items.tip: PurrOne's fuzz: harder and lopsided. Past 80 % it adds an octave up growl. Double-click resets.

items.name: Mix
items.tip: Dry/wet of the three stages together. Double-click resets.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turns Squash on or off.

items.name: Depth
items.tip: Three band push: quiet parts up, loud parts down (OTT style). Dense, bright, loud. Double-click resets.

items.name: Mix
items.tip: Dry/wet of the squash. Double-click resets.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turns Duck on or off.

items.name: Amount
items.tip: How deep the level dips. Double-click resets.

items.name: Shape
items.tip: Pick the dip shape: pump like a sidechain kick, saw, sine, triangle, trance gate and more.

items.name: Rate
items.tip: Speed of the shape as a note length at the tempo, or Free for a rate in Hz.

items.name: Tempo
items.tip: Tempo for the synced rates. The plugin follows the host tempo. Double-click resets.

items.name: Free Hz
items.tip: Speed when Rate is Free. Double-click resets.

items.name: Ducks
items.tip: Before echoes: the sound dips and the delay and reverb tails keep ringing. Tails only: the dry sound stays and only the delay and reverb dip. Everything: the whole output dips.

items.name: Source
items.tip: Shape: the dip follows the chosen shape. Sidechain: the dip follows the loudness of the audio you are previewing in the Editor (the plugin uses its sidechain input). Turn off 'Preview through FX' to use it.

items.name: Restart on key
items.tip: The shape starts from the top every time you press a key.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turns Delay on or off.

items.name: Time
items.tip: Time between repeats. Double-click resets.

items.name: Feedbk
items.tip: How much of each repeat goes back in. Double-click resets.

items.name: Shift
items.tip: Pitch change at every repeat (shimmer delay). Double-click resets.

items.name: Shimmer
items.tip: How much of each repeat is shifted. 0 is a plain delay. Double-click resets.

items.name: Damp
items.tip: Darkens every repeat. Double-click resets.

items.name: Mix
items.tip: Dry/wet of the delay. Double-click resets.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turns Reverb on or off.

items.name: Type
items.tip: Plate: bright, short to medium. Hall: bigger and smoother. Shimmer types add a pitch shifted copy into the tail. Velvet: two halls blended.

items.name: Decay
items.tip: Length of the tail. Double-click resets.

items.name: Size
items.tip: Small room or big room. Double-click resets.

items.name: Pre-dly
items.tip: Gap before the tail starts. Double-click resets.

items.name: Mod
items.tip: Slow movement in the tail. Double-click resets.

items.name: Damp
items.tip: Highs die away faster when lower. Double-click resets.

items.name: Pitch
items.tip: Pitch of the shimmer copy (shimmer types only). Double-click resets.

items.name: Shimmer
items.tip: Amount of the shimmer copy. Double-click resets.

items.name: Mix
items.tip: Dry/wet of the reverb. Double-click resets.

items.name: Width
items.tip: Stereo width. 0 is mono, 200 % extra wide. Double-click resets.

items.name: Level
items.tip: Output level of the sampler and FX. Double-click resets.

items.name: Preview through FX
items.tip: On: the Editor preview (Play) also goes through the FX chain. Off: the preview stays clean and only the sampler gets the FX.

items.name: Apply FX to audio
items.tip: Runs the selection (or the whole file) through the FX chain and writes the result into the audio, including the reverb and delay tail. Undo brings the old audio back.

items.tip: Move the computer keyboard one octave down.

items.name: Oct +
items.tip: Move the computer keyboard one octave up.

items.tip: Stops every sounding note at once.

items.name: Key
items.tip: The key. Notes outside the scale are pulled to the nearest note inside it.

items.name: Scale
items.tip: The scale. Chromatic lets every note through (the pitch is rounded to the nearest semitone).

items.name: Allow or block C on top of the scale
items.tip: Allow or block C on top of the scale. You can also click the keys on the left of the graph.

items.tip: Allow or block C# on top of the scale. You can also click the keys on the left of the graph.

items.tip: Allow or block A# on top of the scale. You can also click the keys on the left of the graph.

items.name: Allow or block B on top of the scale
items.tip: Allow or block B on top of the scale. You can also click the keys on the left of the graph.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turns Auto-Tune on or off.

items.name: Speed
items.tip: Retune speed. 0 snaps at once (the hard, robotic effect). 20 to 60 ms is a clean modern vocal, 100 ms and up keeps it natural. Double-click resets.

items.name: Amount
items.tip: How far the pitch is pulled towards the note. 100 % lands on it, 50 % lands half way. Double-click resets.

items.name: Humanize
items.tip: Slows the correction down the longer a note is held, so long notes can drift a little like a real singer. Double-click resets.

items.name: Vibrato
items.tip: How much of the singer's own vibrato is kept. 0 flattens it (robotic), 100 % keeps all of it. Double-click resets.

items.name: Keep
items.tip: Formant keep. 100 % keeps the vowel colour when the pitch moves (the voice keeps its character). 0 resamples, so the voice gets smaller or bigger with the pitch. Double-click resets.

items.name: Shift
items.tip: Formant shift. Moves the formants on their own: up for a smaller, younger voice, down for a bigger one. The pitch stays. Double-click resets.

items.name: A4
items.tip: The reference pitch for A4. 440 Hz is standard. Double-click resets.

items.name: Original
items.tip: Plays the file as it is, to compare.

items.name: Processed
items.tip: Plays the file with the pitch changes. Space plays it from the cursor.

items.name: Apply to audio
items.tip: Writes the processed pitch into the file (all of it). Undo brings the old audio back.

items.name: Editor
items.tip: Waveform editor: select, cut, copy, paste, trim, fades, normalize, reverse and more, with undo.

items.name: Sampler
items.tip: Turn the audio (or your selection) into an instrument: play it from a keyboard or MIDI, with pitch, loop, slices, envelope and filter.

items.name: FX
items.tip: Drive, Transistor and Fuzz from PurrOne, squash, duck, delay and reverb from the shimmer plugin. Works on the sampler, or on the preview, or can be applied to the audio.

items.name: Auto-Tune
items.tip: Auto-Tune and pitch corrector: pulls a voice or lead onto the notes of a key, from natural to hard and robotic. Runs live in the plugin.

items.name: Pitch Editor
items.tip: Melodyne style editor: the pitch of the file becomes note blobs on a piano roll. Drag notes up, down and sideways, change vibrato, drift and formants per note.

items.name: Harmony
items.tip: Harmony voices (thirds, fifths, octaves that follow the key) and a robot voice locked to one note.

items.name: Test audio
items.tip: Pick a test sound to edit. Reloading it throws away your edits.

items.name: Open file
items.tip: Open your own audio file (wav, mp3, flac, ogg). It is edited in this browser tab only and never uploaded.

items.name: Play
items.tip: Play from the cursor, or the selection. Shortcut: Space.

items.name: Undo
items.tip: Undo the last edit. Shortcut: Ctrl+Z.

items.name: Redo
items.tip: Redo. Shortcut: Ctrl+Y.

items.name: Export WAV
items.tip: Save the edited audio as a 16-bit WAV file to your computer.

items.name: Send to CATalog
items.tip: Hand the edited audio to CATalog's library. Plugin and desktop app only.

items.name: Automation list
items.tip: List of every control. In the plugin each one is a host parameter you can automate and MIDI map.

items.name: Pitch
items.tip: Moves the note up or down. You can also drag the note in the graph. Fine: hold Alt while dragging. Double-click resets.

items.name: Vibrato
items.tip: Scales the note's own vibrato: 0 flat, 100 % as sung, 200 % twice as wide. The pink diamond above the note does the same. Double-click resets.

items.name: Drift
items.tip: Straightens slow drift away from the note's centre (a note that sags or climbs). The orange dot under the note does the same. Double-click resets.

items.name: Fmt shift
items.tip: Formant shift for this note only. The purple square on the right of the note does the same. Double-click resets.

items.name: Snap
items.tip: While you drag a note: Off is free, Semitone lands on whole notes, Scale lands on notes of the key set on the Auto-Tune page.

items.name: Glide
items.tip: How smoothly the pitch moves from one edited note to the next. Double-click resets.

items.name: Keep
items.tip: 100 % keeps the vowel colour when notes move. 0 lets the voice change size with the pitch. Double-click resets.

items.name: Snap all
items.tip: Moves every note to the nearest note of the scale.

items.name: Reset note
items.tip: Puts the selected note back as it was sung.

items.name: Reset all
items.tip: Puts every note back as it was sung.

items.name: Original
items.tip: Plays the file as it is, to compare.

items.name: Processed
items.tip: Plays the file with the pitch changes. Space plays it from the cursor.

items.name: Apply to audio
items.tip: Writes the processed pitch into the file (all of it). Undo brings the old audio back.

items.tip: Window size. Drag any edge or corner of the plugin to resize it; the shape stays the same. Double-click here for 100 %.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turns Harmony on or off.

items.name: Mix
items.tip: Level of all harmony voices together, against the main voice. Double-click resets.

items.name: Follow scale
items.tip: On: each voice is pulled into the key, so a third stays a third of the scale (major or minor as the key needs). Off: exact intervals.

items.name: Voice 1
items.tip: Interval of voice 1 from the singer, in semitones (4 is a third, 7 a fifth, 12 an octave). Double-click resets.

items.name: Level 1
items.tip: Level of voice 1. 0 switches it off. Double-click resets.

items.name: Voice 2
items.tip: Interval of voice 2 from the singer, in semitones (4 is a third, 7 a fifth, 12 an octave). Double-click resets.

items.name: Level 2
items.tip: Level of voice 2. 0 switches it off. Double-click resets.

items.name: Voice 3
items.tip: Interval of voice 3 from the singer, in semitones (4 is a third, 7 a fifth, 12 an octave). Double-click resets.

items.name: Level 3
items.tip: Level of voice 3. 0 switches it off. Double-click resets.

items.name: On
items.tip: Turns Robot on or off.

items.name: Note
items.tip: Robot voice: the whole performance is forced onto this one note (in the nearest octave). Needs Auto-Tune on. Set the speed to 0 for a hard robot.

items.name: Key and scale
items.tip: Harmony and Robot use the key, scale and note switches of the Auto-Tune page. Click to go there.
